turns.tutor:
Hi! We can talk about finished actions with the past. Look: Yesterday I cooked dinner. The action is finished, so cook becomes cooked. Rule: add -ed to a regular verb to talk about a finished action.
Right: Yesterday she jumped.
Wrong: Yesterday she jump.
Your turn! Write the past: Yesterday we ___ (clean) the room.
